title: Adobe Apps on Snapdragon Expand With Native InDesign and On-Device Premiere AI
summary: Adobe expands Snapdragon app lineup with native InDesign and on-device Premiere AI tools
detailed: Qualcomm announced that Adobe Illustrator and InDesign now run natively on Snapdragon X Series PCs, removing the emulation layer for better platform optimization.
The rollout includes a native beta of Substance 3D Painter and new on-device AI features in Premiere such as Enhanced Audio and Sound Source Separation.
Qualcomm demonstrated the Snapdragon-optimized Adobe apps at booth 603 during Adobe MAX 2026, highlighting capabilities across various creator hardware setups.
Independent third-party performance benchmarks and detailed validation metrics were not included with the manufacturer's performance and battery life announcements.
sentences: Adobe Illustrator and InDesign now run natively on PCs powered by Snapdragon X Series processors, Qualcomm announced Nov.
10 in an OnQ blog post by staff product manager Devang Aggarwal.
The two apps join a native roster that already includes Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, Audition, Lightroom, and Media Encoder.
The additions push the Adobe apps on Snapdragon closer to full coverage of a working creative suite, and Qualcomm frames the timing around Adobe MAX 2026, which runs Nov.
Illustrator and InDesign are now generally available as native applications.
Qualcomm says native execution removes the emulation layer and lets Adobe build and optimize directly for the platform architecture.
The company pairs that with hardware claims it has repeated throughout the X Series cycle: multi-day battery life and performance that does not drop when the laptop is unplugged.
In Qualcomm’s description, the combination means a creator no longer chooses between the right tool and the right place, whether finishing a layout in a hotel lobby or at the gate.

For the broader Adobe apps on Snapdragon rollout, the company identifies two priorities: bringing the software to the platform and enabling hybrid AI, meaning models run in the cloud and on device without needing Wi-Fi.
Qualcomm also announced a beta of Substance 3D Painter native to Snapdragon.
Adobe positions the tool for game development, visual effects, product visualization, and digital twin creation, where artists apply materials, masks, and detailed textures to 3D assets.

Qualcomm describes 3D painting as a workload that pushes graphics performance, memory, and interactive viewport responsiveness to their limits and says the native beta moves that work onto thin, mobile creator systems rather than tethering it to a desktop.
In Premiere, Enhanced Audio uses AI models to clean noisy dialogue and repair poor sound effects, music, ambience, and reverb within the same mix.

Qualcomm lists four components: Sound Source Separation splits a clip into speech, reverb, music, and SFX; Separate Crosstalk divides overlapping voices into independent tracks; and Dynamic Auto Ducking lowers music under dialogue without keyframes, moving with the dialogue clip.
Running those models on device is the point.
Qualcomm says on-device processing delivers responsive enhancement while reducing cloud dependence, so editors can rescue rough location audio without a strong connection nearby.
Qualcomm also highlighted Photoshop running natively on Googlebook, which it describes as the first laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence.
On-device AI features there help creators isolate and refine image elements and keep work organized, with Qualcomm citing responsiveness and less reliance on cloud connectivity as the payoff.
The Adobe apps on Snapdragon story has been about closing gaps, and this round closes two of the visible ones.
Illustrator and InDesign were the names creators asked about first, and native availability answers that directly.
What remains unanswered is independent performance data.
Qualcomm’s battery and sustained-performance claims carry a footnote that battery life varies with device, settings, and usage, and no third-party benchmarks accompanied the announcement.
For anyone weighing a Snapdragon creator laptop against an x86 machine, that is the number still missing.
